note: Set A and Set B contain the same substantive claims, all faithful to the page: the 40W/9W/7W light-output equivalence example, the T24 high-efficacy requirement for HARVEST HOME fixtures, the own-switch requirement for high-efficacy luminaires in kitchen/bathroom/closet/laundry, and the vacancy-sensor dimming-bypass requirement. Set B, however, repeats two claims verbatim (the 40W incandescent power and the vacancy-sensor bypass requirement), adding no information and diluting the set. Set A is therefore cleaner and equally complete on the prose content.
remarks: Both sets omit the 'LIGHTING LEVELS' table at the top of the page, which contains engineering-relevant facts: 3 FC for general use/movement (40W bulb at half power), 5-10 FC for simple tasks (40W bulb), 30 FC for large size or high contrast ((4) 40W bulbs), and 50 FC for small size or visually complex ((6) 40W bulbs), each tied to a task (walking bedroom to bathroom, making coffee, chopping vegetable, reading the newspaper). These footcandle levels and bulb counts are arguably the most quantitative content on the page and should be extracted.
